insight: Prisma upsert cannot target the org_id+period composite unique on usage_records; use a transaction with findFirst then create/update
Signature verification needs the raw request body, so the billing webhook route must opt out of the JSON body parser
Every billing query goes through withOrg(), which injects the org_id predicate; a bare prisma call in this area is a tenant-isolation bug
All amounts are stored and passed as integer minor units; formatting to a decimal happens only at the render boundary
The PDF generator depends on node:stream, so the invoice route must declare the Node runtime instead of edge
